title: Tools
html:
Tools

English |

The MCP server (golmet mcp) exposes 15 gm_* tools — the same kit the agentic skills drive, straight over the protocol. Transversal mutation rule: ## Two interfaces, one kit These 15 tools are the AI path: inside Opencode (with golmet mcp registered), the agents act on the kit through these tools - the guards (confirm, dry-run) are enforced on that path. The human path is the CLI in the terminal (commands.md) - the same operations, designed for direct management. MUTATION tools (gm_update, gm_pack_update, gm_pack_publish, gm_upgrade) require confirm=true — without it they fail with the explicit message ("requires confirm=true; nothing was applied") and dry_run lists without applying. | Tool | Scope | Contract | | --- | --- | --- | | gm_validate | workspace | The golmet validate payload (errors/warnings §11 + counters + the context: container/product-workspace). Params: workspace, home. Read-only | | gm_doctor | workspace + engine | The health checklist + the engine_config section (the classified config state). Params: workspace, engine (default opencode), home. Read-only | | gm_graph | knowledge base (T1-T5) | The golmet graph payload - deterministic knowledge graph (workflow/pack/docs via what, combinable with +). Params: workspace, projects_root, scope, out, max_nodes, from_json, what. Read-only on sources; writes the 3 artifacts to the destination | | gm_lint | kit/config/packs/workspace | The L1–L10 sweep — findings with severity + remediation. Params: workspace, engine, home. Read-only (never confirm) | | gm_status | workspace | The entity-state dashboard. Param: workspace. Read-only | | gm_next | workspace | The recommended next action (p1..p9). Param: workspace. Read-only | | gm_index | workspace | Rebuilds golmet.index.json. Param: workspace. WRITE (the index is kit-managed) | | gm_update | engine/config | Materializes the kit content (essencial/completo + packs). Params: engine, confirm, dry_run, full, force. Mutation — requires confirm=true | | gm_pack_update | pack | Pack sync + overlay (never discards accumulation). Params: repo, engine, confirm. Mutation — requires confirm=true | | gm_pack_list | packs | The installed packs inventory (id, kind overlay/state). Read-only | | gm_eval | skill/fixture | The deterministic eval of a fixture (criteria.yaml). Params: skill, fixture, workspace. Read-only | | gm_eval_reports | evals | Lists the most recent eval reports (~/.golmet/eval-reports). Read-only | | gm_jev_classify | text | The Jev classifier (TypeSafe System One) — typed responses with calibrated probabilities. Params: text, questions (JSON). Degradable: without key/endpoint, a clear error | | gm_upgrade | binary | The kit binary self-update: check=true read-only · confirm=true applies. Mutation — requires confirm=true |
